review_call_outcome_proof_measurement.basis: Proof CLI release and assertion exits with registered-writer disposable PostgreSQL observations; includes fixture setup, concurrent fixture contention and teardown. backfill_deal_document_text_suite_measur.basis: Complete synthetic CLI suite. No production calls. Includes typed parser refusal before scan and dry-run tooling independence.

document_intake_main_merge_measurement.basis: Merged main reproduces shard estimate 481323ms above unchanged 480000ms budget. Both parents pass. Hosted merge-group shard 4 ran this suite successfully in 2518ms; merged local suite passed in 2018ms. 6000ms rounds above twice the hosted measurement. Shared cold setup remains budgeted separately. No watchdog, headroom or shard-count change.

recording_provenance_measurement.basis: Four local enforcement tests including rejection of a whole-registry pin. Discovered automatically by ops/ci.sh gates.

mcp-server/typescript/gate.test.ts.basis: Measured expanded strict-option full-command suite 43203ms; 60000ms rounds above the observed duration; types class owns this suite, outside the legacy unit runner.

ops/guard-selftest.py.basis: Complete real-process suite passed 2219/2219 and 2969 monotonicity probes. Container elapsed includes setup; budget is twice observed duration rounded up to a minute. Shared host and emulation are conservative local evidence, not hosted timing parity.

prospect_research_proof_measurement.basis: Only the 21-read cap scenario uses the existing production 30-second budget. Pinned image baseline five-second scenario fails, and its old ten-second outer harness also expires with the production deadline. Short deadline refusal remains unchanged.

lead_contact_address_proof_measurement.basis: Pinned b5e93fd6 image, uid 1001, four CPUs, Linux amd64 through Rosetta. Five-second cap fixture exhausted after 21 wrapper calls; existing production 30-second budget completed all 22 calls in 7425ms including teardown. Only the read-cap scenario uses this budget; timeout refusal remains one second.

recorded_comps_proof_runtime_measurement.basis: Existing CLI suite extended with a clean runtime, locked archive refusals, stalled evaluation, late process launch and temporary-directory deadline cleanup and timer cancellation. No new suite.

email_next_step_closed_date_proof_measur.basis: Includes one real registered-tool disposable PostgreSQL fixture capture and eight local CLI scenarios. No new MCP shard.

pr_release_comments_suite_measurement.basis: Existing suite extended to 13 tests, contract-checked GitHub REST fixtures, deploy recovery, terminal job guards and executable proof pass/fail. No network.

proof_runtime_fixture_suite_measurement.basis: Existing proof suites with shared runtime fixture adapters. Python and Node use the shared interpreter via CARR_CI_PYTHON; local elapsed includes setup and teardown. Seven database-dependent Node tests skipped.

proof_transport_suite_measurement.basis: Expanded existing suite with runtime HTTP refusal, async curl and shared-reader admission, including fixture teardown. No new suite.

post_call_exact_edge_whitespace_suite_me.basis: Local full proof CLI suite with registered-handler disposable Postgres fixture setup and teardown. Verification metadata only; no Node shard added.

field_census_suite_measurement.basis: Existing intake suite extended with census transitions. Measured full suite duration. No new suite.

historical_win_labels_suite_measurement.basis: Canonical runner with shared snapshot template, registered handler, exclusions and 1001-group refusal. Ten times measured suite duration; template setup is counted separately. Cold standalone samples include snapshot setup. No throughput claim.

action_card_target_suite_measurement.basis: Planning estimate rounds above the measured 2676ms lifecycle process plus the 5684ms warm-snapshot reply case. Cold snapshot setup retains the hosted 167478ms floor separately. Canonical local process samples include cross-worktree waits on the kernel-owned disposable-PostgreSQL lease; observed holder and waiters were unrelated fixture jobs. Hosted shard jobs do not share that local lease across worktrees. This is an estimated isolated CI budget, not a measured whole-file speed or hosted-parity claim. Hosted current-head CI must verify it.

reply_action_links_measurement.basis: New reply suite separated from the legacy raw-cluster lead suite to preserve CI-service isolation. 10000ms rounds above the measured canonical reply group plus process overhead. Shared cold snapshot setup is budgeted separately. The unchanged lead suite retains its prior measured entry. No throughput claim.

shard_budget_measurement.basis: Both complete real SQL proof runs passed six tests with zero skips. Round each observed maximum up to ten seconds, including local fixture lock contention. Retain hosted cold setup floor and 80% watchdog policy. No speedup claim.

timing_refresh.multiplier_basis: ceil(hosted cold setup / minimum local cold setup); milliseconds are conservative budgets, local_samples_ms are observed process durations

deliverable_suite_measurement.basis: Existing conservative local-to-hosted multiplier; hosted snapshot setup and watchdog preserved. Uses maximum observed suite duration including teardown; no speedup claim.

watch_v2_suite_measurement.basis: Canonical runner separates snapshot-template setup from each suite. Record measured suite duration without double-counting cold setup; standalone timing is retained separately. Suite entries retain the maximum observed canonical timings. Final run includes strict transition assertions and a deterministic queued stale-removal race. Existing hosted cold-setup floor is unchanged.

watch_suite_measurement.basis: Existing local-to-hosted conservative multiplier; preserves hosted snapshot setup and watchdog limits. Local measurements include fixture teardown. Busy 18-core host; no speedup claim.

portal_session_suite_measurement.basis: Observed hosted canonical runner duration; replaces unmeasured-suite fallback. Retains hosted setup floor, five shards and watchdog headroom.

calendar_strict_instants_suite_measureme.basis: Observed successful hosted canonical runner duration. suiteBatches places this pure suite in the parallel bulk pool. Retains hosted setup floor, five shards and watchdog headroom.

composer_suite_measurement.basis: Observed hosted canonical runner duration; replaces unmeasured-suite fallback. Retains hosted setup floor, five shards and watchdog headroom.

activity_attribution_suite_measurement.basis: Measured process duration including teardown. No speedup claim.

mail_needs_partner_suite_measurement.basis: Per-suite process elapsed, synthetic disposable PostgreSQL, no production reads.

client_anniversary_read_suite_measuremen.basis: Successful hosted canonical runner timings including child teardown. PostgreSQL snapshot setup is counted separately by snapshot_template_ms. Replaces local standalone timings multiplied by 10; retains five shards, cold setup floor and 20 percent watchdog headroom.

quiet_owner_filter_measurement.basis: Six passing tests including cold disposable PostgreSQL setup and teardown and recorded-response proof replay. No speedup claim.

quiet_owner_proof_measurement.basis: Five passing tests replay the committed real registered responses. No network or history dependency.

Existing PostgreSQL weight remains above the measured consolidated suite; parser/unit weight rounds above its measured 12 tests. Synthetic loads check exact counts, not production capacity.
